mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.title, DATE_FORMAT(n.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, n.created_by AS createdBy, CASE WHEN nr.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS `read` FROM notification n LEFT JOIN notification_read nr ON n.id = nr.notification_id AND nr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (title, create_time, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{createTime}, #{createdBy})
INSERT IGNORE INTO notification_read (notification_id, user_id) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{userId})
